messages:
Lina: Quick design review — deployment history panel mock attached. Main issues I see: long list of versions makes the progress bars noisy, the canary badge colors are hard to scan, and users asked for faster filtering by time range. Figma: https://figma.com/file/abcd — can we go through small UX changes?

Sam: Looks good. Two quick asks: 1) canary duration needs clearer labeling (e.g. "Canary — 30m" vs "Canary (30m)"); 2) for A/B tests we should show experiment id and traffic split inline. :+1:

Matt: From infra side we can support a compact view and server-side time filters. Suggest adding query params: `?since=30d&compact=true` and paginating by deployment time. Also we should avoid fetching full logs for collapsed rows.

Jordan: UX idea — collapse older deployments into a condensed stack with a summary row that expands on click. Replace full-width progress bars with small inline sparklines + percentage label so rows stay single-line.

Jada (a11y): A few a11y nits: contrast on the light-blue canary chip is low when paired with grey text. Need >= 4.5:1 for readable text. Recommend changing chip fill to #004EA8 and using white text, or increase font-weight to 600. Also progress bars need `role=progressbar` and `aria-valuenow`/`aria-valuemin`/`aria-valuemax`.

Lina: Good call, Jada. I'll try the #004EA8 and heavier weight in the mock. For the condensed stack, should we show a summary tooltip on hover with counts (deployed/failed/rolled-back)?

Claire: Yes — product wants a quick rollback entry point in the summary row: small "Rollback" menu with last commit message + reason. Also we need the ability to surface the rollout metadata (who triggered, tags, experiment id) in the compact view.

Sam: Agree. Also default sorting should be newest first and add a search by version id. For A/B experiments, show `traffic: 60/40` inline.

Matt: Quick implementation note for engineers: the filter API should accept boolean expressions, e.g.:
```
status:canary OR status:live AND since:7d
```
We should index by (status, created_at) to keep queries fast.

Jordan: Visual detail — swap colored chips for small icons + text to help colorblind users (for example, a small flame icon for canary + text). That reduces reliance on color alone.

Jada (a11y): Also add keyboard expand/collapse (Enter/Space) on the summary row and focus ring visible (2px outline) when keyboard navigating.

deploy-bot: Lina uploaded a new frame to Figma: https://figma.com/file/abcd (frame: compact-history-v2)

Lina: Thanks everyone — I'll iterate on compact mode, update colors to #004EA8 for canary, add aria attributes, and post the updated mock by EOD. :raised_hands:
